partner_baseline_findings.note: Current partner files were used as a no-shrink baseline. Dott Poland and exact Voi Le Havre remain additive registry gaps in this lane; Dott broad France coverage is not used to attribute Le Havre because the lane contract explicitly makes Le Havre Voi-only.

No lane label had an acceptable Atlas city/cluster bind.
